verdict.rationale: Keycloak's Server Administration Guide documents WebAuthn as a first-class sign-in method. It covers WebAuthn in the default browser flow, LoginLess WebAuthn, and a dedicated Passkeys section with Conditional UI/autofill, Modal UI and mediation, so the passkey half of the story is clearly delivered. The evidence never mentions magic links or email OTP as built-in passwordless methods, so the other half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented magic-link sign-in, documented email OTP sign-in, independent or hands-on corroboration of the passkey flows.
